connections.label: Label
connections.supprimer_confirm: "{{label}}": credentials will be erased, accounts and history kept.
connections.web_warning: In a browser, the Binance, Kraken, Yahoo, Enable Banking, and Trade Republic APIs are blocked (CORS). Sync works in the Android app; here, use manual tracking and CoinGecko.
connections.aucune: No connections. Add one below: credentials stay stored on this device.
connections.ajouter_hint: Read-only API keys only. They're encrypted in the device's secure storage (Android Keystore) and never leave the device.
connections.ajouter_note:
Enable Banking (free, personal use) covers checking accounts via PSD2: French banks, and Revolut via Lithuania. PEA, brokerage, and life insurance accounts aren't covered by banking APIs: track them manually with automatic prices.

Trade Republic uses an unofficial API (Android only, 2FA on every sync).
connections.av_hint: Optional: a free Alpha Vantage key (alphavantage.co) lets the Diversification tab classify the sector of your stocks and ETFs. Without a key, only geography (via ISIN) and crypto categories stay available.
connections.av_enregistree_texte: Sector classification is now available on the Diversification tab.
connections.av_supprimer_confirm: Already-classified holdings keep their data; new ones won't get sector enrichment until a key is set again.

connectionForm.aide_kraken: Create an API key on kraken.com → Settings → API with only the "Query Funds" permission.
connectionForm.aide_binance: Create an API key on binance.com → API Management, read-only (uncheck trading and withdrawals).
connectionForm.secret_hint: Stored encrypted on the device, never sent anywhere except the official API.

ebConnect.intro:
Enable Banking gives free access (personal use, "restricted production") to your banks' payment accounts via PSD2.

1. Create an account on enablebanking.com then an application (Production environment).
2. Enable Banking only accepts https redirect URLs: register the address of the bounce page there (the project's docs/eb-callback.html file, deployed via GitHub Pages), or any https URL otherwise — you'll then paste the return URL by hand after approving at the bank.
3. Paste the Application ID, the PEM private key, and that same https URL here.
ebConnect.redirect_url_hint: Must match the URL registered in the Enable Banking application.
ebConnect.private_key_hint: Stored encrypted on the device (Android Keystore). Only used to sign requests to api.enablebanking.com.
ebConnect.pays_hint: Revolut connects via Lithuania; Fortuneo and BoursoBank via France.
ebConnect.url_recue_hint: If the automatic return didn't work: copy the full URL of the page reached after approving at the bank (it contains ?code=…) and paste it here.
